d:
In this video, I explore Ghadames, one of Libya’s most mysterious cities hidden deep inside the Sahara Desert. From its ancient maze-like streets and unique rooftop pathways to traditional homes, local culture and food, I experience a side of Libya rarely seen. Then we head deep into the Sahara dunes, where our adventure takes an unexpected and dangerous turn.
